_: The presets of other instruments a device opens: interoperability, the one place the website names another product or a model (the owner, 25 November 2026). Only what the app does today, or 'coming' where it says so.

builtin.vintergatan.text: Opens Vital and Serum 2 presets, their wavetables and modulation with them.

builtin.jet-8000.text: Opens JP-8000 and JP-8080 patches and performances, as SysEx, MIDI files or .pfm.

builtin.norrsken.text: Opens Nord Lead 2X programs, performances and kits, as SysEx or MIDI files.

builtin.six-operator-fm-synth.text: Opens DX7 voice banks and single voices.

builtin.vireo.text: Opens Virus TI Singles from SysEx; loading the wavetables of its firmware is coming.
